summary: Transfer entropy reveals significant cross-hemispheric information flow supporting H003. Crucially, the flow is ASYMMETRIC: SH→NH dominates at 3-6 month lags (z=6.7 and z=5.7, p<0.001), while NH→SH dominates at 12-month lag (z=2.5, p=0.012). No significant transfer at 1-month lag. This suggests SH is the primary short-term radiative driver while NH influences SH at annual timescales — possibly linked to NH land-ocean contrast and seasonal cycle phase.
